description: This file defines the class 'PendingLeaveRequestSummary' within the OrangeHRM system. The class is responsible for summarizing pending leave requests that require approval, encapsulating logic for filtering leave requests based on employee numbers and status, and providing methods to access related metadata such as group ID, group name, and count of pending requests.

classes.name: PendingLeaveRequestSummary
classes.description: A class implementing 'ActionSummary' to generate summaries of pending leave requests that require managerial approval, utilizing filtering parameters and services from the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with employee numbers, setting up the leave request search filter parameters for pending leave requests.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID categorizing this summary, fixed to '1'.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the group, here 'Leave Requests To Approve'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Fetches and returns the count of pending leave requests based on the configured filter parameters.
